securityNotes: Read SKILL.md and all 10 themes/*.md files in full at the pinned SHA. Each theme file is a short, self-contained color-palette + font-pairing spec (hex codes, 2 font roles, use-case guidance) -- pure data/prose, no scripts, no network calls, no credential access, no hidden instructions. theme-showcase.pdf is a binary preview asset, listed in files[] with its blob SHA but not opened (not a text file); the skill instructs the agent to display it unmodified, which is consistent with its role as a visual reference, not executable content.
overlaps: brand-guidelines (same repo, rejected) covers a single hardcoded brand's colors/fonts; theme-factory instead offers 10 selectable generic themes plus a 'create your own theme' fallback, making it the more broadly reusable of the two

proposedEntry.name: theme-factory
proposedEntry.description: Applies one of 10 curated color-palette + font-pairing themes (each with named hex colors, header/body font roles, and recommended use cases, shown via a theme-showcase.pdf) to slide decks, documents, or HTML artifacts, or generates a new custom theme on the fly when none of the presets fit, following a show-choices / confirm / apply workflow.
triggers: apply a theme to this deck
pick a color and font palette for this document
generate a custom theme for this artifact
inputs: optional description of desired mood for a custom theme
outputs: a styled artifact using the chosen theme's colors and fonts
for custom themes, a new theme spec (palette + font pairing) shown for confirmation before applying
